# 长难句精刷五年高考真题 --- ## 第一期 **2022年新I卷C篇** ### 原文呈现与词汇分析 They $\textcolor{pink}{\text{discovered}}$ that the $\textcolor{pink}{\text{upper}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{and}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{lower}}$ front teeth of ancient human adults were aligned (对齐), making it hard to $\textcolor{pink}{\text{produce}}$ labiodentals, which are formed by touching the lower lip to the upper teeth. Later, our jaws changed to an $\textcolor{pink}{\text{overbite}}$ structure (结构), making it easier to produce such sounds. **词汇分析：** * **discover** - 发现 | **dis-** 【同源单词】：disable, disabled, disadvantage, dismissive * **upper** - 上部的 | **lower** - 下部的 * **produce** - 产生 | **pro-**, 向前，**-duc**, 拉；【同源单词】deduce, educate * **overbite** - 上包齿 | **over-**, 在上 --- ### 结构分析 $\underline{\text{They}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\underline{\text{discovered}}}$ {that the $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{upper and lower front teeth}}$ of ancient human adults $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were aligned}}$}, (making it hard to produce labiodentals), {which $\textcolor{pink}{\text{are formed}}$ by touching the lower lip to the upper teeth}. Later, our jaws changed to an $\textcolor{pink}{\text{overbite}}$ structure (结构), making it easier to produce such sounds. --- ### 考点分析 They discovered that the upper and lower front teeth of ancient human adults were aligned (对齐), $\textcolor{pink}{\text{making it hard to produce labiodentals}}$, which are formed by touching the lower lip to the upper teeth. Later, our jaws changed to an overbite structure (结构), making it easier to produce such sounds. **33. Why was it difficult for ancient human adults to produce labiodentals?** A. They had fewer upper teeth than lower teeth. B. They could not open and close their lips easily. C. Their jaws were not conveniently structured. D. Their lower front teeth were not large enough. --- ## 第二期 **2023年新II卷D篇** ### 原文呈现与词汇分析 They $\textcolor{pink}{\text{surveyed}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{several}}$ hundred park-goers, asking them to $\textcolor{pink}{\text{submit}}$ a $\textcolor{pink}{\text{written}}$ summary online of a meaningful interaction they had with nature in the park. The researchers then examined these submissions, coding (编码) experiences into different categories. **词汇分析：** * **survey** - **sur-** 表示“在旁边”或“在上面”，如 surface（表面）等；**-vey**, **-vis-** “看”的变形表示“看”，如 previse（预知）、evidence（证据） * **several** - 词根 **sev-** 可能来自 seven（七） * **submit** - 词根 **sub-** 表示“下面”，**-mit** 表示“发送”，如 commit（犯罪，承担义务） * **written** - 表示用书面形式表达信息，**-en** 是构成形容词的后缀 --- ### 结构分析 $\underline{\text{They}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\underline{\text{surveyed}}}$ several hundred $\textcolor{cyan}{\underline{\text{park-goers}}}$, (asking them to submit a written summary online of a meaningful interaction {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{they}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{had}}$ with nature in the park}). The researchers then examined these submissions, coding (编码) experiences into different categories. --- ### 考点分析 They surveyed several hundred park-goers, asking them to submit a written summary online of a meaningful interaction they had with nature in the park. The researchers then examined these submissions, coding (编码) experiences into different categories. For example, one participant’s experience of “We sat and listened to the waves at the beach for a while” was assigned the categories “sitting at beach” and “listening to waves.” Across the 320 submissions, a pattern of categories the researchers call a “nature language” began to emerge. **13. Why did the researchers code participant submissions into categories?** A. To compare different types of park-goers. B. To explain why the park attracts tourists. C. To analyze the main features of the park. D. To find patterns in the visitors’ summaries. --- ## 第三期 **2023年新II卷D篇** ### 结构分析 $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{The key finding}}$ of the study $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{was}}$ {that {when $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{crowds}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were}}$ further $\textcolor{pink}{\text{divided}}$ into smaller groups} {that $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were allowed}}$ to have a discussion}, $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{the averages}}$ from these groups $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were more accurate}}$ than those from an equal number of independent individuals.} --- ### 重点词汇与中文翻译 | independent | $\text{adj.}$ 独立的 | | :--- | :--- | | **【词根词缀】** | de-, 向下；pend, 悬挂 | | **【同源单词】** | pendulum（钟摆）, append（附加） | | **【例句及翻译】** | If the clubs cannot conclude a deal, an $\textcolor{pink}{\text{independent}}$ tribunal will decide.
如果俱乐部之间无法达成协议，将由一个独立的仲裁委员会来裁定。 | **中文翻译：** 研究的关键发现是，当人群进一步分成较小的组，并允许这些组进行讨论时，这些组的平均数比同样人数的独立个体更准确。 --- ## 第四期 **2022年全国甲卷B篇** ### 结构分析 In humans, {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{babies}}$ can $\textcolor{pink}{\text{put}}$ a round shape in a round hole (from around one year of age)}, but {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{it}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{will be}}$ another year before {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{they}}$ are $\textcolor{pink}{\text{able}}$ to do the same (with less symmetrical（对称的）shapes)}}. --- ### 重点词汇 | symmetrical | $\text{adj.}$ 匀称的、对称的 | | :--- | :--- | | **【词根词缀】** | sym- 共同 + -metr- 测量 + -ical 形容词词尾 | | **【同源单词】** | sympathy（同理心/同情）, photosynthesis（光合作用）, synchronize（同步） | | **【例句及翻译】** | The laws of physics are $\textcolor{pink}{\text{symmetrical}}$ for translational displacements.
物理定律对平移是对称的。 | --- ## 第五期 **2022年全国甲卷B篇** ### 结构分析 $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{The beauty}}$ (of rereading) $\textcolor{pink}{\text{lies in}}$ $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{the idea}}$ {that our bond (with the work) is based on our present mental register}. It's true, the older I get, the more I feel time has wings. But with reading, it's all about the present. It's about the now and what one contributes to the now, because reading is a give and take between author and reader. Each has to pull their own weight. --- ### 考点分析 **24. Why does the author like $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{rereading}}$?** A. It evaluates the writer-reader relationship. B. It's a window to a whole new world. C. It's a substitute for drinking with a friend. D. It extends the understanding of oneself. --- ## 第六期 **2020北京卷** ### 原文呈现 But if AI does eventually prove to be our downfall, it is unlikely to be at the hands of human-shaped forms like these, with recognizably human motivations such as aggression (敌对行为). Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from AGI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else. **中文翻译：** 然而，如果人工智能最终被证明是我们的失败原因，这不太可能是由于像这样具有明显人类动机（如攻击性）的人形形态的 AI 的行动所致。相反，我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·博斯特罗姆的观点，他认为，人工智能带来的最严重风险并不来自于针对人类的决定，而是来自于对既定目标的执着追求，而不顾一切。 **短语积累：** * The prisoners got good treatment $\textcolor{pink}{\text{at the hands of}}$ his captors. * **含义：** 由某人或通过某人的机构完成 / 出于某人之手 * **翻译：** 这些俘虏从捕获者那里受到了良好的待遇。 --- ## 第七期 **2021年浙江卷** ### 结构与意群分析 To us, {$\textcolor{yellowgreen}{\text{the most likely explanation}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{appears}}$ to be} {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{that}}$ $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{the basis}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{lies}}$ (in their living) (with humans)}, {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{which}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{gives}}$ them $\textcolor{yellowgreen}{\text{a lot of exposure}}$ (to human facial expressions)}, {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{and}}$ $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{this exposure}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{has provided}}$ them (with many chances) (to learn) (to distinguish between them)}, $\underline{\text{Müller said.}}$ * **Step one：句子结构分析** 介词短语 + 主句 + 表从 + 定从 + and 并列复句 * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 对我们来说，最可能的解释似乎是，它们与人类生活在一起，这使它们经常接触到人类的面部表情，而这种接触使它们有很多机会学会区分它们，穆勒说。 --- ## 第八期 **2021年全国乙卷D篇** ### 结构与意群分析 {The $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{differences}}$ (between $\textcolor{yellowgreen}{\text{most of the groups}}$) $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were}}$ statistically $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{insignificant}}$;} {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{however}}$, the $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{participants}}$ (in the 70 decibels group) significantly outperformed the other groups.} {—those $\textcolor{navajowhite}{\text{exposed}}$ (to a level of noise) (similar to background chatter) (in a coffee shop)—} * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 + however + 并列复句（插入语） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 大多数组之间的差异在统计学上没有显著性；然而，70 分贝组的参与者——那些暴露在类似于咖啡店背景聊天水平的噪音中的人——的表现明显优于其他组。 --- ## 第九期 **2021年新I卷C篇** ### 结构与意群分析 In 1934, (an increasingly $\textcolor{navajowhite}{\text{concerned}}$) $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{nation}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{took}}$ firm $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{action}}$ (to stop the destruction) (of migratory (迁移的) waterfowl and the wetlands) (so vital to their survival.) (with the passage of the Migratory Bird Hunting Stamp Act (Act)) * **Step one：句子结构分析** * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 1934 年，随着《候鸟狩猎印花税法案》（Act）的通过，一个日益关注的国家采取了坚决行动，以阻止对候鸟（迁徙水禽）和对其生存至关重要的湿地的破坏。 --- ## 第十期 **2021年全国乙卷B篇** ### 结构与意群分析 $\underline{\text{That said}}$, $\underline{\text{(to be honest)}}$ the only people who ever ring our home phone are our Baby Boomers parents, to the point where we play a game and guess who is calling before we pick up the phone (using Caller ID would take the fun out of it). * **插入语：** $\underline{\text{That said}}$, $\underline{\text{(to be honest)}}$, * **主句：** the only $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{people}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{are}}$ our Baby Boomers parents * **定从：** {who ever $\textcolor{pink}{\text{ring}}$ our home phone}, 修饰主句的 people * **状语从句/结果：** {to the point where we $\textcolor{pink}{\text{play}}$ a game and $\textcolor{pink}{\text{guess}}$} * **宾从：** {who $\textcolor{pink}{\text{is}}$ calling} (guess 的宾语) * **状从：** {before we $\textcolor{pink}{\text{pick}}$ up the phone} (定从中的时间状语) * **独立解释：** {(using Caller ID $\textcolor{pink}{\text{would take}}$ the fun out of it)}. * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 + 定从 + 介词短语（定从 + doing） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 也就是说，说实话，唯一打我们家庭电话的人是我们的婴儿潮一代的父母，我们甚至会在接电话前玩游戏，猜猜是谁打来的（使用来电显示会失去乐趣）。 --- ## 第十一期 **2021年全国乙卷D篇** ### 结构与意群分析 Indeed, {the researchers $\textcolor{pink}{\text{found}}$ {that face-to-face interactions and conversations $\textcolor{pink}{\text{affect}}$ the creative process}}, {and yet a co-working space or a coffee shop $\textcolor{pink}{\text{provides}}$ a certain level of noise while also $\textcolor{navajowhite}{\text{providing}}$ freedom (from interruptions).} * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 + and 并列复合句 + while 时间状从（省略 is） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 事实上，研究人员发现，面对面的互动和对话会影响创作过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡店在产生一定程度的噪音的同时，也提供了不受干扰的自由。 --- ## 第十二期 **2021年全国乙卷B篇** ### 结构与意群分析 (Of those $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{Australians}}$) {who still $\textcolor{pink}{\text{have}}$ a landline}, {a $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{third}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{concede}}$ (承认) that $\textcolor{pink}{\text{it’s}}$ not really necessary and $\textcolor{pink}{\text{they’re keeping}}$ it (as a security blanket)} -- {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{19 percent}}$ say they never use it} {while a further $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{13 percent}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{keep}}$ it (in case of emergencies.)} * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句（定从）+ 宾从 + and + 并列复合句 + “--” 并列句（宾从 + while 转折复合句） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 在那些仍然拥有座机电话的澳大利亚人中，三分之一承认这不是真的必要的，他们保留它只是作为安全保障，19%的人表示他们从不使用它，而另外 13%则保留它以备紧急情况。 --- ## 第十三期 **2021年浙江卷B篇** ### 原文与整理分析 A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realized that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say chocolate into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response. **整理分析：** (A couple of years ago), {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{film-maker David Bond}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{realized}}$ {that his children, (then $\textcolor{navajowhite}{\text{aged}}$ five and three,) $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were attached}}$ (to screens)} (to the point) {where he $\textcolor{pink}{\text{was}}$ $\textcolor{navajowhite}{\text{able to say}}$ chocolate (into his three-year-old son’s ear)(without getting a response).}} * **主句：** {film-maker David Bond $\textcolor{pink}{\text{realized}}$ * **插入语：** then $\textcolor{navajowhite}{\text{aged}}$ five and three, * **宾从：** {that his children, $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were attached}}$ (to screens)} * **Step one：句子结构分析** 介词短语 + 主句（宾从 + 介短）+ 介短 + 定从 + 介短 * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 几年前，电影制片人大卫·邦德意识到他的孩子，当时分别为五岁和三岁，对屏幕上的事物到了让他可以在他三岁的儿子耳朵里说巧克力而没有得到任何反应的地步上。 --- ## 第十四期 **2021年全国I卷D篇** ### 结构与意群分析 {Many people now $\textcolor{pink}{\text{misunderstand}}$ $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{emotional intelligence}}$ (as almost everything) 1、(desirable) 2、(in a person’s makeup)} 3、{that $\textcolor{pink}{\text{cannot be measured}}$ by an IQ test}, (such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and people skills.) * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 + 介短（定从）+ 介短 * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 现在很多人错误地将情商误解为一个人的构成中几乎包括一切不可通过智商测试来衡量的可取之处，比如品格、动机、自信、心理稳定、乐观和人际技巧。 --- ## 第十五期 **2021年全国乙卷D篇** ### 结构与意群分析 {Plastic $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{straws}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{are}}$ (by no means) the $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{biggest source}}$ (of plastic pollution)}, {but $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{they’ve}}$ recently $\textcolor{pink}{\text{come}}$ (under fire) because {$\textcolor{yellowgreen}{\text{most people}}$ don’t $\textcolor{pink}{\text{need}}$ $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{them}}$ (to drink with)} {and, (because of their small size and weight), $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{they}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{cannot be recycled}}$.}} * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 + but 复合句 + because 状从 + and +（并列复合句 + because of 介短） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 塑料吸管绝对不是塑料污染的主要来源，但近来它们受到了批评，因为大多数人不需要它们来喝水，而且由于其小尺寸和轻重，它们无法回收利用。 --- ## 第十六期 **2023年新I卷D篇** ### 结构与意群分析 $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{The key finding}}$ (of the study) $\textcolor{pink}{\text{was}}$ {that {when $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{crowds}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were}}$ further $\textcolor{pink}{\text{divided}}$(into smaller groups)} {that $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were allowed}}$ (to have a discussion)}, {$\textcolor{cyan}{\text{the averages}}$ (from these groups) $\textcolor{pink}{\text{were more accurate}}$ (than those) (from an equal number) (of independent individuals)}}. * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 + {that 表从 + when 复合句 + that 定从 + 主句 + than（比较对象）} * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 这项研究的重要发现是，当大的群体被进一步分成更小的群体并允许讨论时，这些群体（估算）的平均值比同样数量的独立个体的平均值更准确。 --- ## 第十七期 **2023年新I卷D篇** ### 结构与意群分析 (For instance), $\textcolor{cyan}{\text{the average}}$ ($\textcolor{cyan}{\text{obtained}}$ from the estimates) (of four discussion groups of five) $\textcolor{pink}{\text{was significantly more accurate}}$ (than the average) (obtained from 20 independent individuals). * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主语（非谓语）（介词短语）+ 谓语 +（than 比较级）（非谓语） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 例如，从四个五人讨论小组的估算结果得出的平均值明显比从 20 个独立个体得出的平均值更准确。 --- ## 第十八期 **2021年浙江卷A篇** ### 结构与意群分析 $\textcolor{cyan}{\underline{\text{He was thrilled}}}$ (to be doing the comedy) {that he always $\textcolor{pink}{\text{felt}}$ he should do}, but (even during his last few years), $\textcolor{cyan}{\underline{\text{he always}}}$ $\textcolor{pink}{\underline{\text{had}}}$ $\textcolor{cyan}{\underline{\text{a sense of curiosity}}}$, (wondering {what new role or challenge $\textcolor{pink}{\text{might be}}$ just around the corner}). * **Step one：句子结构分析** 主句 +（定语从句）+ but +（介词短语）+ 并列句 +（非谓语 + 宾语从句） * **Step two：句内意群分析** 学会对介词所管辖范围的分析 **中文翻译：** 他对能够做自己一直以为应该做的喜剧感到非常兴奋，但即使在他生命的最后几年，他始终保持着好奇心，想知道可能就在不远处的新角色或挑战是什么。 --- ## 第十九期 **2021年全国乙卷A篇** ### 结构与意群分析 (For the biggest stadiums in the world), we $\textcolor{pink}{\text{have used}}$ data (supplied by the World Atlas list so far), {which $\textcolor{pink}{\text{ranks}}$ them by their stated permanent capacity, (as well as updated information from official stadium websites.)} * **Step one：句子结构分析** （介词短语）+ 主句（非谓语）+ 定语从句（介词短语 + 非谓语） * **Step two：句内意群分析** **中文翻译：** 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们使用了世界地图列表提供的数据，该列表根据其声明的永久容量进行排名，以及官方体育场网站上的最新信息。 --- ## *   **【词根破译】** 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{sub-} &\rightarrow \text{under (在...下面)} \\

\end{aligned}

*   **【考纲双主轨释义】**
    *   *轨道 A（常规/阅读）*：**提交，呈递**（= hand in）
    *   *轨道 B（高阶/写作）*：**屈服，投降，顺从**（= yield / surrender）

    *   `submit sth. to sb.` 向某人提交某物
    *   `submit to sb./sth.` 屈服于……（注意这里的 to 是**介词**，后接 noun/doing）
*   **【真题回顾与写作迁移】**

        *   *升级*：Under no circumstances should we **submit to** temporary setbacks. (在任何情况下我们都不应向暂时的挫折屈服。)

*   **【考纲双主轨释义】**

*   **【词根破译】** 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{out-} &\rightarrow \text{surpass / exceed (超过/胜过)} \\
\text{perform} &\rightarrow \text{to do / act (表现/履行)} \\
\text{outperform} &\rightarrow \text{表现得比...更好}
\end{aligned}
$$
*   **【前缀 $\text{out-}$ 核心词汇链（高考提分利器）】**
    *   `outnumber` (v.) 在数量上超过
    *   `outweigh` (v.) 比……更重要/重
    *   `outdo` (v.) 胜过，打败
*   **【真题回顾与写作迁移】**
    *   *真题（第八期）*：...the participants in the 70 decibels group significantly **outperformed** the other groups. (70分贝组的参与者表现明显优于其他组。)
    *   *写作高分句（应用文·对比分析）*：
        *   *升级*：In terms of efficiency, the newly introduced system **outperforms** the traditional one by a wide margin. (在效率方面，新引入的系统明显优于传统系统。)

---

## 6. independent /ˌɪndɪˈpendənt/ (adj.)
*   **【词根破译】** 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{in-} &\rightarrow \text{not (否定)} \\
\text{de-} &\rightarrow \text{down (向下)} \\
\text{pend} &\rightarrow \text{to hang (悬挂)} \\
\text{-ent} &\rightarrow \text{adj. suffix (形容词后缀)} \\
\text{independent} &\rightarrow \text{不向下悬挂靠别人的 } \rightarrow \text{独立的}
\end{aligned}
$$
*   **【同源词汇链（熟记 pend 词根）】**
    *   `depend` (v.) 依靠（挂在...下面）
    *   `suspend` (v.) 悬挂；暂缓
    *   `impending` (adj.) 即将发生的（悬在头顶的）
*   **【高考核心搭配】**
    *   `be independent of` 独立于……，不受……支配
*   **【真题回顾】**
    *   *真题（第三期/第十六期）*：...more accurate than those from an equal number of **independent** individuals. (比同样数量的独立个体更准确。)

---

## 7. obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (v.)
*   **【词根破译】** 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{ob-} &\rightarrow \text{in front of / toward (朝向/获得)} \\
\text{tain} &\rightarrow \text{to hold (握住/保持)} \\
\text{obtain} &\rightarrow \text{伸手握住 } \rightarrow \text{（通过努力）获得}
\end{aligned}
$$
*   **【同义词辨析】**
    *   `get` (口语常用) $\rightarrow$ `acquire` (逐渐学得/养成) $\rightarrow$ `obtain` (正式，指付出努力后得到)
*   **【真题回顾与写作迁移】**
    *   *真题（第十七期）*：For instance, the average **obtained** from the estimates... (例如，从估算中得出的平均值……)
    *   *写作高分句（应用文·结语）*：
        *   *升级*：Further information can be **obtained** by visiting our official website. (欲获取更多信息，请访问我们的官方网站。)

## 三、 地道短语与习语表达（读后续写与高分应用文神笔）

### 1. at the hands of (Unit 6)
*   **含义**：**出于某人之手，由某人所致（多指不好的事情）**
*   **点拨**：在写作中用来替代被动语态中的 `by`，能极大提升句子的客观性和地道感。
*   **续写妙用**：
    *   *升级*：He suffered great humiliation **at the hands of** his rivals. (他受到了对手的极大侮辱。)

### 2. pull one's weight (Unit 5)
*   **含义**：**做好分内事，尽职尽责**
*   **点拨**：字面意思是“拉动自己的体重”，引申为在团队中不拖后腿。
*   **应用文妙用**：
    *   *升级*：In our group project, everyone is expected to **pull their own weight**. (在我们的团队项目中，每个人都被期望尽职尽责。)

### 3. come under fire (Unit 15)
*   **含义**：**受到批评，遭到指责**
*   **点拨**：原指“遭到炮火袭击”，引申为遭受舆论或公众的谴责。
*   **议论文妙用**：
    *   *升级*：The new plastic-limit policy has recently **come under fire** from small business owners. (新的限塑政策最近遭到了小企业主的批评。)

### 4. on call (Unit 20)
*   **含义**：**待命，随叫随到**
*   **点拨**：常用于医生、消防员、IT支持人员或现在流行的“零工经济”（Gig Economy）中独立承包商的工作状态。

### 5. security blanket (Unit 12)
*   **含义**：**安全感来源，心理保障**
*   **点拨**：源自婴儿抱着的安全毯，在成人语境中指任何能给你带来心理安慰但实际上可能并无大用的东西。
